subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Skateboard Platform
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Skateboard Platform.

hook.text: Most modern EVs mount their battery pack flat across the entire floor, creating a skateboard shape.

buildup.text: This layout drops the center of gravity low, giving EVs cornering stability that SUVs never had.

discovery.text: The flat floor also frees up cabin space—no transmission tunnel means more room for passengers.

twist.text: Some manufacturers now make the battery pack a structural part of the car's body, saving weight.

climax.text: Tesla's structural battery pack acts as both energy storage and the car's floor, eliminating parts.

punchline.text: The battery isn't just in the car—it is the car's foundation.

quiz.question: What advantage does the skateboard battery layout provide?
options: Low center of gravity and more cabin space

details.summary: The skateboard platform places the battery flat in the vehicle floor with motors at the axles, creating a low, flat chassis that can support many different body styles on one shared architecture.
details.whyItMatters: Skateboard platforms revolutionized EV design by lowering the center of gravity for better handling, freeing interior space, and enabling manufacturers to produce multiple models from a single platform.
takeaways: Batteries sit flat in the floor, lowering the center of gravity
Motors mount at the axles, enabling easy all-wheel-drive setup
One skateboard can underpin sedans, SUVs, and trucks

faq.question: Who popularized the skateboard platform concept for EVs?
faq.answer: GM introduced the concept with its Autonomy project in 2002, but Tesla made it mainstream with the Model S. Nearly every EV manufacturer now uses some variant of the skateboard architecture.

faq.question: Does a flat battery floor make EVs ride higher than sedans?
faq.answer: Somewhat, but the battery pack is thin enough that most EV sedans maintain a similar ride height to conventional cars. The slight elevation is offset by the very low center of gravity the pack provides.
